text.en: Say one kind thing to yourself, out loud or in your head.
text.my: ကိုယ့်ကိုယ်ကို ကြင်နာတဲ့စကားလေးတစ်ခွန်း အသံထွက်ပြောပါ၊ ဒါမှမဟုတ် စိတ်ထဲမှာပဲ ပြောပါ။

text.en: Write down one thing you like about who you are.
text.my: ကိုယ့်ရဲ့ ဘယ်အချက်လေးကို သဘောကျလဲဆိုတာ တစ်ခုလောက် ရေးချပါ။

text.en: Do one small thing today just because you enjoy it.
text.my: ဒီနေ့ ကိုယ်ပျော်လို့ပဲ လုပ်ချင်တဲ့အရာလေးတစ်ခု လုပ်ပါ။

text.en: Say yes to one small thing you usually shy away from.
text.my: ပုံမှန်ဆို ရှောင်တတ်တဲ့ အရာလေးတစ်ခုကို ဒီတစ်ခါ လက်ခံကြည့်ပါ။

text.en: Remember something you did well this week and give yourself a nod.
text.my: ဒီတစ်ပတ်မှာ ကိုယ်ကောင်းကောင်းလုပ်နိုင်ခဲ့တာလေးတစ်ခုကို သတိရပြီး ကိုယ့်ကိုယ်ကို အသိအမှတ်ပြုလိုက်ပါ။

text.en: Speak up kindly once today, even in a tiny way.
text.my: ဒီနေ့ တစ်ခါလောက် ကိုယ့်အမြင်ကို ကြင်ကြင်နာနာ ပြောပြပါ။ နည်းနည်းလေးပဲဖြစ်ဖြစ်ပေါ့။

text.en: Let yourself feel one feeling for a minute without judging it.
text.my: ခံစားချက်တစ်ခုကို တစ်မိနစ်လောက် အကဲဖြတ်မနေဘဲ ခံစားခွင့်ပေးလိုက်ပါ။

text.en: Send a kind message to a friend.
text.my: သူငယ်ချင်းတစ်ယောက်ဆီ ကြင်နာတဲ့စာလေး ပို့လိုက်ပါ။

text.en: Play a song that feels like a hug.
text.my: ပွေ့ဖက်ထားသလို ခံစားရစေတဲ့ သီချင်းတစ်ပုဒ် ဖွင့်နားထောင်ပါ။

text.en: Take three slow breaths before you start your next task.
text.my: နောက်တစ်ခု စမလုပ်ခင် အသက်ကို ဖြည်းဖြည်း 3 ကြိမ် ရှူထုတ်ပါ။

text.en: Tidy one small corner of your desk.
text.my: စားပွဲပေါ်က နေရာလေးတစ်ခုကို သပ်သပ်ရပ်ရပ် လုပ်လိုက်ပါ။

text.en: When you finish something, say "well done" to yourself.
Drink a glass of water slowly.
text.my: ရေတစ်ခွက်ကို ဖြည်းဖြည်းသောက်ပါ။

text.en: Stretch gently for one minute, only as far as feels nice.
text.my: ကိုယ်သက်သောင့်သက်သာရှိသလောက်ပဲ တစ်မိနစ်လောက် ညင်ညင်သာသာ အကြောလျှော့ပါ။

text.en: Thank your hands for something they did today.
text.my: ဒီနေ့ လက်နဲ့လုပ်ခဲ့တဲ့အရာတစ်ခုအတွက် ကိုယ့်လက်တွေကို ကျေးဇူးတင်လိုက်ပါ။

text.en: Look out of a window for one minute and notice three things.
text.my: ပြတင်းပေါက်ကနေ အပြင်ကို တစ်မိနစ်လောက်ကြည့်ပြီး သတိထားမိတာ 3 ခုကို မှတ်ကြည့်ပါ။

text.en: Put your phone down for ten minutes and just be.
text.my: ဖုန်းကို 10 မိနစ်လောက် ချထားပြီး ဘာမှမလုပ်ဘဲ ကိုယ့်အတိုင်းလေး နေပါ။

text.en: Take five slow breaths, in through the nose and out through the mouth.
text.my: နှာခေါင်းကနေ အသက်ကို ဖြည်းဖြည်းရှူသွင်းပြီး ပါးစပ်ကနေ ရှူထုတ်ပါ။ အဲဒီလို 5 ကြိမ်လုပ်ပါ။

text.en: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. Stay like that for three breaths.
Make yourself a warm drink and drink it without a screen.
Name five things you can see right now, then four you can hear.
Light a candle or switch on a soft lamp and sit with it for a minute.
Close your eyes for one minute and notice the sounds around you.
Put one hand on your heart and breathe slowly until it feels a little quieter.
Step outside, or open a window, and take one deep breath of fresh air.
Write down one worry, then write one small kind thing you can do about it.
Wash your hands slowly and feel the water.
Do one thing at a time for the next ten minutes.
Listen to one calm song all the way through.
Let your eyes rest on something green or blue for a minute.
Slow your steps while you walk to the next place you go.
Breathe out for longer than you breathe in, four times.
Put away one thing that has been nagging at you.
Wrap yourself in a soft blanket or sweater for a few minutes.
Whisper to yourself: it is okay to slow down.
Write yourself a two-line love note and keep it somewhere you will find it.
Look in the mirror and say one thing you appreciate about yourself.
Do something today that is only for you, even if it takes five minutes.
Forgive yourself for one small thing from this week.
Treat yourself the way you would treat your best friend today.
Put on an outfit that makes you feel like you.
Give yourself permission to rest without earning it first.
Write down three things that make you, you.
Take a photo of something that made you smile today.
Say no to one thing that you do not have the energy for.
Spend a few minutes on a hobby you love.
Remember a time you were proud of yourself and let yourself feel it again.
Compliment yourself in your head the next time you pass a mirror.
Make your favourite snack and enjoy it slowly.
Say thank you to yourself for getting through today.
Choose one thing on your list and let it wait until tomorrow.
Tell yourself: I am doing my best, and my best is enough.
Stand tall with your shoulders back for one minute and breathe.
Share one opinion today, even a small one, like which song to play.
Write down three things you are good at.
Introduce yourself to someone new, or say hello first.
Accept a compliment today with just a smile and a thank you.
Try one small thing you have been putting off, for five minutes only.
Ask for something you need, kindly and clearly.
Recall a fear you once got through and remind yourself of it.
Choose the thing you actually want to eat or do, and say so.
Say "I'm not sure yet, let me think" instead of agreeing right away.
Notice one thing you handled well today and say it out loud.
Look up when you walk, and let yourself take up your space.
Write down one thing you will be brave about this week.
Say your name and one thing you love about yourself, as if introducing a friend.
Let a mistake from today be a lesson, then let it go.
Wear something that makes you feel strong.
Tell yourself: I can do hard things, one small step at a time.
Let yourself cry or sigh if you need to. Feelings are allowed to move.
Write a few lines about how you feel, then close the page and breathe.
Reach out to one person who feels safe and say hi.
Do one small thing that helps you feel looked after, like a shower or a snack.
Put a photo or reminder that hurts out of sight for now.
Tell yourself: healing is not a straight line, and today is allowed to be slow.
Go outside for a short walk and let the air do some of the work.
Make your bed or tidy one spot, so your space feels a bit softer.
Write down one thing you are learning about what you need.
Choose a comforting show, book or song and give yourself that time.
Drink some water and eat something small, even if you are not hungry.
Let one feeling be here for a minute without trying to fix it.
Say to yourself: I am allowed to take up space with how I feel.
Put on clean, cosy clothes that feel good on your skin.
Write down one thing you are grateful for today, however small.
Give yourself an early night, if you can.
Remind yourself of one good thing that is still yours.
Thank your body for one thing it did for you today.
Drink a full glass of water and notice how it feels.
Stretch your neck and shoulders gently for one minute.
Wear something comfortable that feels kind to your body.
Take a short walk and notice how your feet feel on the ground.
Rest your eyes away from every screen for five minutes.
Moisturise your hands or face and take your time.
Eat one meal slowly, and notice what you enjoy about it.
Rest if your body asks you to, and do not call it lazy.
Dance to one song in your room, just for fun.
Sit or lie in a comfy position for a few minutes and relax your muscles.
Hug yourself for ten seconds.
Give yourself a soft, kind word about your body.
Unfollow or mute one account that makes you feel bad about yourself.
Take a warm shower or wash your face with care.
Stand up and roll your shoulders back three times.
Say to your body: thank you for carrying me.
Write down the three most important things for today, and only those.
Take a real break before you feel tired: stand up and stretch.
Tidy your workspace for two minutes.
Start with the smallest task on your list and just do five minutes.
Say to yourself: I do not need to be perfect, I only need to begin.
Close extra tabs and focus on one thing for twenty minutes.
Reward yourself with something small when you finish a task.
Ask a classmate or colleague one question you have been wondering about.
Write down one thing you have learned recently.
Take three slow breaths before you open a hard message or document.
Set a timer for fifteen minutes and work gently until it rings.
Plan one thing you will look forward to after work or study.
Drink water and refill your bottle for your next stretch of work.
Say "that is enough for today" and stop when you have done your main thing.
Break one big task into three tiny steps and write them down.
Notice one small win from today before you finish.
Tell yourself: I am learning, and learning takes time.
